rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING THE FINANCIAL LITERACY OF OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS (OFWs), AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to provide OFWs the necessary skills and learning to make sound decisions in all matters concerning their assets and liabilities including their resources, investments, debts, credits, and other financial transactions.

Proposes to mandate financial literacy training seminars which shall become an integral part of the Pre-Departure Orientation Seminar (PDOS) and Post-Arrival Training Seminars (PATS).

Seeks to tasked the Department of Finance (DOF) to formulate training modules; conduct financial and responsibility training programs; apprise OFWs on financial opportunities and pitfalls; ensure accessibility of qualified online advisers/counsellors; and disseminate knowledge-expanding activities that promote financial literacy among OFWs and their dependents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2019-05-20

rows.abstract:
Seeks to respond to the recent partial veto of the Tax Amnesty Program that was approved in December 2018 and recognizes a general tax amnesty for all unpaid internal revenue taxes in order to improve the State's economic standing by expanding its taxpayer base, and decloging the dockets of the BIR and the courts of tax cases.
Provides that the grant of the general tax amnesty shall cover all taxes such as, but not limited to income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, donor's tax, value-added tax, percentage taxes, excise tax, and documentary stamp tax collected by the BIR, including value-added tax and excise taxes collected by the BOC for taxable year 2017 and prior years.
Proposes to incorporate provisions for the lifting of bank secrecy and authorizing an automatic exchange of Information for certain cases involving tax administration.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE POOR INTERNET SPEED AND CONNECTIVITY IN THE COUNTRY AS A NATIONAL EMERGENCY, AND GRANTING PRESIDENT RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE EMERGENCY POWERS AND PRESCRIBING URGENT MEASURES NECESSARY AND PROPER TO EFFECTIVELY ADDRESS SUCH PREDICAMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

Seeks to grant the President the authority, among others, to require concerned LGUs and other national agencies to issue the necessary permits in relation to the application for the construction of cell site or other similar facilities within a period of seven (7) days or more under exceptional circumstances.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PHILIPPINE GOVERNMENT TO ISSUE EDUCATIONAL BONDS FOR THE BENEFIT OF TERTIARY STUDENTS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Defines Educational Bond as a long-term government security issued by a national government with corresponding interest and sovereign guarantee.

Proposes an issuance of treasury bonds in the name of every Filipino at birth which shall be used exclusively to augment any and all financial assistance extended by the government through the proceeds of said security instrument upon maturity, release of which shall be to the qualified beneficiary only under the ff. conditions:

a) At the time he or she reaches 18 years of age, must be enrolled in undergraduate-post-secondary programs in any public or private educational institution; and b) He or she must be a part of household included in the National Household Targeting System for Poverty Reduction (NHTS-PR).

rows.abstract:
Aims to improve our waters by:  ensuring and improving the country's sustainable community-based water sources; protection of watersheds and water sources; lending program to Local Water Districts; sewage and sanitation resource management; as well as flood control and flood risk management.

Seeks to better manage the entire cycle of our water - from sourcing to water treatment and sewage to achieve more sustainable water supply and better overall management of our irrigation, sanitation, flood management, and sewage.

rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING THE RESOURCE MANAGEMENT OF THE WATER SECTOR, CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF WATER, SEWAGE, AND SANITATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to appropriate and release the sum of Three Hundred Million Pesos (P300,000,000.00) for the
organization of the Department and its initial operations.

Tasks the Department with developing and implementing comprehensive program including, but not limited to:
a) implementing necessary policy and resource reforms with respect to the management of water, sewage, and 
sanitation;
b) monitoring and evaluating compliance with the Social Contract of the President and the Millenium Development Goals as they relate herein.
c) formulating a national updated road map to address the requirements of the State; and
d) improving conservation of water and increasing system efficiencies.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 69 OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881, ALSO KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE, IMPOSING A FINE UPON A NUISANCE CANDIDATE AND/OR PERSONS IN CONSPIRACY WITH SUCH CANDIDATE FOR THE MALICIOUS FILING OF A CERTIFICATE OF CANDIDACY
rows.abstract:
Intends to deter any person from repeatedly filing or causing the filing of Certificate of Candidacy \"to put the election process in mockery or disrepute or to cause confusion among the voters by the similarity of the names of the registered candidates or by other circumstances or acts which clearly demonstrate that the candidate has no bona fide intention to run for the office.\"

Proposes to impose the penalty of a fine not less than ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS each to the nuisance candidate himself/herself and the person/s who were found to have been in conspiracy with or have induced such candidate to file such certificate, upon proof of malice or gross bad faith.

rows.author: I062;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 12 AND 68 OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881, ALSO KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE, DISQUALIFYING PERSONS CONVICTED OR SANCTIONED IN ANY COURT, TRIBUNAL OR BODY FROM BEING DECLARED AS A CANDIDATE OR FROM HOLDING ANY PUBLIC OFFICE PENDING APPEAL OF CONVICTION, WHERE THE PENALTY IMPOSED INCLUDES TEMPORARY OR PERPETUAL DISQUALIFICATION
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the issue wherein many aspiring candidates still run for public office despite the fact that a court, tribunal or administrative body found compelling evidence to decide on their guilt and impose upon them corresponding penalties including perpetual or temporary disqualification from holding any public office.

States that should the judgment imposing the sentence be brought up on appeal, the candidate shall still be disqualified until such time the appeal reverses the conviction and acquits such person.

Provides that any person convicted of election offenses enumerated in Sec.68 of the Omnibus Election Code shall likewise be disqualified from being declared a candidate or, if elected, from holding public office pending appeal of such conviction.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROFESSIONALIZING THE PRACTICE OF THE PARALEGAL PROFESSION IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to give Filipinos who have been practicing paralegal work the necessary recognition and government
assistance to develop the profession.

Defines Paralegal profession as government-sanctioned performance of specifically delegated substantive legal
work for which a lawyer is responsible, including but not limited to legal research, drafting of simple 
legal documents, liaising with judicial and quasi-judicial bodies, etc. and for which a license to practice
law is not required under prevailing rules and regulations.

Provides for the creation of the Professional Regulatory Board of Paralegals; licensure examination requirement, 
qualifications and rating; issuance of the certificate of registration and professional license; roster of paralegals
in good standing; prohibition on the practice and Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Program of paralegal.
